title: hook
text: Two Indian AI teams. Same models, same prices. One should pick Llama. The other would pay two and a half times more for it. PolyToken tells you which team you are, and proves why.

title: the cause
text: The reason is the tokenizer. This Telugu sentence is a hundred and two tokens on Llama, most of them single bytes, and seventeen on Sarvam. Type the same thing in Tenglish, and Llama needs barely more than English. How your users write decides your bill.

title: the agent at work
text: This is Raitu Mitra, a fictional Telugu voice assistant for farmers. I ask PolyToken which model fits. Nemotron plans each step and says why. It reads the company's conversations only through Zetaris: chats, configuration, token counts and verified prices, through federated SQL. Every observation lands in the Meterless World Model with its source and time. On the service map, each call lights up with its latency.

title: the answer
text: The profile is all Telugu script, straight from speech recognition. Llama 3.1 8B has the lowest price per token, but on this traffic it needs five times the English tokens, so it costs two point six times the best fit. Gemma 3 4B wins, at about a hundred and forty rupees a month in estimated content cost. And PolyToken stays honest: voice latency isn't verified yet, so this is a cost recommendation, with quality to check on your own sample.

title: four companies
text: Now four companies. Samudra and Paisa, whose users type Tenglish and Hinglish: Llama 8B is the cheapest fit. Swara and Raitu, voice agents in Hindi and Telugu: Gemma wins. The cheapest model depends on how your users write.

title: trust
text: Every number opens its receipt: the formula, the inputs, the query and when it was fetched. A deterministic checker recomputes every claim from raw evidence before you see it, and drops anything it can't prove.

title: close
text: Zetaris for the data. Meterless for memory and evidence. NVIDIA Nemotron for reasoning. PolyToken: the model-fit advisor for Indian-language AI. Every token accounted for.
